observations.why: Declares a calibration state as settled fact, performing institutional authority over the instrument's readiness without invoking we-ness or exchange.
The collective 'We' enacts a shared-body verification move — the team as one unit confirming against a reference, pooling the act rather than attributing it to a rank-holder.
Structured label-and-value formatting enacts a declarative register that institutionalizes the instrument and its calibration as authoritative record entries.
